subject: Rebilling & application of partial remittance across Atlas entities - VAT treatment
content:
From: Alex Roy <alex.roy@atlasbio.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Applying partial remittance across US/EU entities + VAT re-bill

Hi Priya,

Quick one from our AR team — we have a partial remittance of USD 120,000 referencing invoice RWI-84721 (total outstanding USD 250,000). Atlas split: Atlas Biotech Ltd (EU) and Atlas Inc. (US). We need the cash to be applied so that:

- USD 80,000 is applied to the EU entity balance (Atlas Biotech Ltd / VAT ID: NL123456789B01)
- USD 40,000 is applied to the US entity balance (Atlas Inc. / Tax ID: 98-7654321)

Because the EU entity is getting the larger allocation, our tax team asks whether Redwood can reissue or credit the original invoice and issue two new invoices that show the EU reverse-charge treatment (where applicable) so we can reclaim/record correctly. If reverse charge isn't feasible, please advise the minimal re-billing text your finance team needs (VAT note, VAT IDs, currency breakouts).

We attached a short proposal (payment_proposal.pdf) with the incoming wire reference and bank remittance stub.

Can you confirm: 1) you can apply the credit as outlined, 2) whether two invoices/credit notes will be issued, and 3) an ETA for the documents so our AP team can close the payment?

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alex Roy
Head of Finance, Atlas Biotech
alex.roy@atlasbio.com
+44 20 7946 0123

---

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Roy <alex.roy@atlasbio.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jul 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Applying partial remittance across US/EU entities + VAT re-bill

Alex — thanks for the clear note and the stub. Looping in Kim (Finance) and Ben (Payments ops) so we can move fast.

Short answers up front: we can apply the USD 120,000 split as requested and we can reissue invoices/credit notes with the appropriate tax text.

Proposed operational steps (for alignment):

1) Redwood will create a single credit note against RWI-84721 that nets the 120,000 payment and then issue two replacement invoices:
   - Invoice RWI-84721-A to Atlas Biotech Ltd (EU) for USD 80,000 with explicit VAT reverse-charge line and Atlas VAT ID on the invoice.
   - Invoice RWI-84721-B to Atlas Inc. (US) for USD 40,000 with US tax jurisdiction note (no VAT).

2) Finance will apply the incoming wire to the credit note and then post the two new invoices to the corresponding legal entities/AR accounts.

3) Ben — can you confirm the ledger/GL posting codes you want for the EU vs US splits and whether the transaction memo should reference the original invoice and the Atlas wire reference?

4) Kim — any compliance caveats for the EU reverse-charge wording we should include on the invoice to support Atlas reclaim/record?

I attached a quick allocation matrix (allocation_matrix.csv) so Finance/AR can import the split worksheet.

If that plan looks good, Alex — we'll aim to have the credit + two reissued invoices in 48 hours and will share DocuSign/Drive links.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.narian@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Roy <alex.roy@atlasbio.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jul 2028 12:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Applying partial remittance across US/EU entities + VAT re-bill

Priya / Ben — thanks for the heads up. Alex — thanks for the remittance details.

Operational notes from Finance (action items listed):

- GL mapping: please apply as follows when posting the credit and new invoices:
  * EU allocation (Atlas Biotech Ltd): AR ledger 1200-EU / Revenue code 4003-EU / Tax code RC-VAT (reverse charge).
  * US allocation (Atlas Inc.): AR ledger 1200-US / Revenue code 4003-US / Tax code NO-VAT.

- Invoice mechanics: we will issue a single credit note referencing RWI-84721 to absorb the incoming USD 120,000, then create two new invoices (numbers to be provided) tied to the correct legal entity. The EU invoice will include: vendor VAT ID (Redwood NL VAT: NL987654321B01), customer VAT ID (Atlas NL123456789B01), and the standard EU reverse-charge header: "VAT reverse charge — customer liable for VAT (Article 44 EU VAT Directive)".

- Supporting docs required: to satisfy our tax/recording flow, we need the Atlas PO or a signed payment remittance confirmation with the wire reference (you included the stub — thanks). If Atlas can also provide the customer VAT registration page or a copy of the VAT cert, that speeds any reclaim processes.

- Timing: assuming we have the confirmation above, Finance will:
  * Issue credit note & new invoices within 48 business hours (target Mon 22 Jul COB),
  * Post application of the incoming wire the same day invoices are created, and
  * Email final PDF invoices + accounting journal entries to acct+redwood@atlasbio.com and to priya.natarajan@redwood.com.

Attached: gl_mapping.xlsx (GL codes + posting memo template). Ben — please route the journal entries to our AP/GL team and confirm when the AR items are closed.

Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

---

From: Alex Roy <alex.roy@atlasbio.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.narian@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jul 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Applying partial remittance across US/EU entities + VAT re-bill

Thanks — that plan is fine. We will provide the VAT cert and the signed PO by EOD today. Bank remittance reference for the 120,000 wire: ATLB-20280719-0093.

Please confirm when the credit note is posted and the two new invoices are available — once we get the PDFs we will close the AR items on our side.

Appreciate the quick handling.

Best,
Alex

Attachments referenced in thread: payment_proposal.pdf (pdf), allocation_matrix.csv (csv), gl_mapping.xlsx (xlsx), remittance_stub.pdf (pdf)
